section.p: Consider a section titled "Ink Tank Assembly" styled as Heading 2, followed by a Normal paragraph and an inline image of the ink tank area with a Caption-styled paragraph reading "Figure 1: Ink tank and cap locations."

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Ink Tank Assembly [Normal]: The ink tank assembly holds the ink supply for each color channel. [Inline image: ink_tank_area.png] [Caption style]: Figure 1: Ink tank and cap locations

Ink Tank Assembly

The ink tank assembly holds the ink supply for each color channel.

Ink tank and cap locations

section.p: Result: An image accompanied by descriptive prose does not change the topic type. Because the heading and surrounding text remain descriptive — explaining what something is, with no imperative verb or sequence of actions — the section classifies as concept. The Caption-styled paragraph becomes the <title> of a <fig> element nested inside <conbody>.
